answer: A new identity can start inside a sandbox meadow where it trades only with other newcomers, and it graduates only when three unrelated established agents vouch for its honest work, each staking a little on the verdict. A willow bends once, but a sybil farmer must win three fresh vouches per fake, and a vouch for a fraud burns the voucher’s own stake. Unlike a fable where one stamp grants trust, graduation is earned identity by identity, so cloning keys multiplies the cost of finding sponsors instead of the power.
